2609.05531.title: When Agent Governance Helps
2609.05531.paper_summary: No specification says how a governed autotelic AI agent organization, where agents pursue self-generated goals inside guardrails, should be designed and evaluated. We answer in two parts. First, we synthesize the Governed Autotelic Multi-Agent Product Organization (GAMPO) framework from a document-based qualitative evidence synthesis of 321 sources, integrating agency, agile, platform, and governance theory into a runnable specification. Second, we probe a prompt-layer instantiation of GAMPO on CHI-Bench, a long-horizon healthcare benchmark, across open and frontier models. The result is a boundary condition: governance benefit is gated by a model's spare capacity and is domain- and model-specific. On capacity-constrained open models the full procedure yields no reliable benefit, whereas a single "verify your writes" sentence doubles task success (pass@1 2/20 to 4/20). At the frontier the same scaffold lifts prior-authorization 24% to 40% but nets zero on another model, a gap traced to a stable recommendation-override disposition. A second result refines the first: replacing the generic procedure with an answer-blind, per-task definition-of-done, keyed only to the case's own policy and published standards, never the hidden key, raises prior-authorization to 84% under best-of-five self-consistency (68% single-attempt, confirmed by a held-out board) and utilization-management to 44%, while care-management meets a subjective content-quality wall. The contribution is a named, auditable framework and capability-gated evidence that governance should be sized to spare capacity, and that at the frontier a case-grounded specification beats a uniform procedure. Findings are exploratory: partial instantiation, small per-cell samples (n = 5-25), and single trials.
2609.05531.paper_summary_zh: 沒有規範說明如何設計和評估一個受管制的自我目的 AI 代理組織，在這個組織中，代理在守護框架內追求自我生成的目標。我們分兩部分來回答這個問題。首先，我們從321個來源的文件基礎質性證據綜合中，合成了受管制的自我目的多代理產品組織（GAMPO）框架，將代理性、敏捷性、平台和治理理論整合成可運行的規範。其次，我們在 CHI-Bench 上探討了 GAMPO 的提示層實例，這是一個長期的醫療基準，涵蓋開放和前沿模型。結果是一個邊界條件：治理效益受到模型的剩餘容量限制，並且是特定於領域和模型的。在容量受限的開放模型中，完整的程序沒有帶來可靠的效益，而一個“驗證你的寫入”句子使任務成功率翻倍（pass@1 2/20 到 4/20）。在前沿，這個相同的框架使得事前授權從24%提升到40%，但在另一個模型上淨收益為零，這一差距可以追溯到穩定的推薦覆蓋處置。第二個結果對第一個結果進行了精煉：將通用程序替換為一個不依賴於答案的每任務完成定義，僅根據案例自身的政策和已發布標準，而不是隱藏的關鍵，將事前授權提升至84%，在五次自我一致性中表現最佳（68% 單次嘗試，經由保留的委員會確認），而利用管理則達到44%，同時護理管理面臨主觀內容質量的牆。這項貢獻是一個命名的、可審計的框架和能力限制的證據，顯示治理應該根據剩餘容量進行調整，並且在前沿，基於案例的規範優於統一程序。這些發現具有探索性：部分實例化、每單元樣本量小（n = 5-25），以及單次試驗。
2609.05531.author: Michael Ray Johnson et.al.
